meta.title: Aries 2027 — Vishnu ji drafts, Sakshi notes
meta.version: v5 script draft (mol-bhaav engine, reviewed) (times are estimates until voices exist)
meta.cta: send to an Aries friend + link to the month-wise Aries 2027 guide (link-based only; owner rule)
meta.text_rules: min 48 px, max 2 text items on screen, captions count
meta.source: Aries 2027 summary given by the owner, 23 Nov 2026 (Vedic: Saturn 12th then 1st, Jupiter 5th, Rahu 10th / Ketu 4th)

beats.line: Ek minute, Prabhu! Aries ka 2027 likhne se pehle, wakeel ki bhi suniye.
beats.picture: Night cloud study. Vishnu ji on his cloud; the 'ARIES 2027' scroll floats and a magic quill writes by itself. Sakshi zooms in on a small cloud, black wakeel coat over her outfit, diary floating open, raises a polite hand; the quill pauses mid-word.
beats.camera: Opens mid-motion on the quill; whip to Sakshi.
beats.card: Hook card from frame 0: 'ARIES 2027: BHAGWAN SE MOL-BHAAV?'

beats.line: Wakeel? Mesh walon ko wakeel nahi… brake chahiye.
beats.picture: Vishnu ji amused, eyebrow up. Cut-in: a cartoon ram charges at full speed, no brakes, skids past a 'STOP' sign.
beats.camera: Push in, cut-in on the ram.

beats.line: Pehle kadwi dawai: Shani dev ki Sade Sati.
beats.picture: Vishnu ji calm and serious; the scroll writes 'SADE SATI' in deep blue; a small respectful Shani symbol glows (Shani dev not shown).
beats.camera: Slow push in, light dims a touch.

beats.line: Saade saat saal?! Prabhu, thoda discount… teen kar do?
beats.picture: Sakshi's eyes go wide, then she bargains like at a sabzi mandi: three fingers up (no gripping), hopeful puppy face.
beats.sound: Vine boom, then a cash-register ding.

beats.line: Shani dev discount nahi, mehnat ka phal dete hain. Aur Guru ji ki kripa bhi hai.

caption_chunks.text: Aur Guru ji ki kripa bhi hai.

beats.picture: Vishnu ji gentle smile, shakes his head; a soft golden Jupiter glow rises over the scroll and the gloom clears. Sakshi exhales.
beats.camera: Gentle pull back, warm light returns.
beats.card: Card: 'SHANI = MEHNAT KA PHAL · GURU = KRIPA' + 'Vedic maanyata'

beats.line: Sehat: March-April aur August-October, dhyaan. July? Full power.
beats.picture: Diary page: HEALTH with the two careful windows; flexing-arm doodle on 'Full power'.
beats.card: Card: 'HEALTH ⚠ 9 Mar–26 Apr · 24 Aug–8 Oct' + small 'Doctor ki salah zaroor lein'

beats.line: Toh July mein gym join kar lein?

caption_chunks.text: Toh July mein gym join kar lein?

beats.picture: Sakshi excited, a tiny dumbbell doodle pops in her diary.

beats.line: Join toh har saal karte ho. Is baar jaana bhi.

caption_chunks.text: Join toh har saal karte ho.

beats.picture: Vishnu ji deadpan, slow blink; the dumbbell doodle sags. Sakshi caught out, sheepish grin.
beats.camera: Two-shot, tiny punch-in on the deadpan.

beats.line: Naukri: pressure. Office mein koi kaan bhar sakta hai.

caption_chunks.text: Office mein koi kaan bhar sakta hai.

beats.picture: Cut-in: a tiny cartoon office; a faceless colleague whispers into a boss's huge ear. Vishnu ji raises one brow.

beats.line: Naam bata do, Prabhu! Notice bhej deti hun!
beats.picture: Sakshi rolls up her wakeel sleeves, cunning squint; a 'LEGAL NOTICE' page floats up from her diary.

beats.line: Notice nahi, dhyaan. April-May, September-October: koi risk mat lena.
beats.picture: Vishnu ji laughs softly; the 'LEGAL NOTICE' page folds into a paper plane and turns into 'DATES'.
beats.card: Card: 'JOB: NO RISKS 5 Apr–6 May · 21 Sep–21 Oct'

beats.line: Paisa average se behtar. Best: March-April aur June. Ferrari nahi, FD.
beats.picture: Gold coins drift up; Sakshi's diary sneaks a red car doodle (no logo) that turns into 'FD' on the last words; she pouts.

beats.line: Pyaar? June se November Guru ji ka saath. Bas August-October, behas nahi.

caption_chunks.text: June se November Guru ji ka saath.

beats.picture: Hearts float up; Sakshi blushes; on 'behas' a tiny storm cloud passes over a heart.
beats.card: Card: 'LOVE + SHAADI ✓ 26 Jun–26 Nov · Vedic maanyata' + 'careful 24 Aug–8 Oct'

beats.line: Mesh wale aur bina behas? Prabhu, isme bhi discount?
beats.picture: Sakshi throws up her hands (open palms), comic despair; the ram doodle in her diary huffs steam.

beats.line: Ghar mein badon ki baat dil pe mat lo.

caption_chunks.text: Ghar mein badon ki baat dil pe mat lo.

beats.picture: Cut-in: a warm family home with diyas. Vishnu ji calm, palm on heart.
beats.card: Card: 'FAMILY: badon ka samman' + 'PROPERTY: sirf saaf deal'

beats.line: Mummy ki daant bhi?
beats.picture: Sakshi, hopeful loophole face.

beats.line: Wo daant nahi, prasad hai. Sar aankhon pe.
beats.picture: Vishnu ji amused smile, gentle head tilt; Sakshi bows her head, giggling.

beats.line: Upay: Mangalwar Sundarkand, chaandi pehno, netraheen ko bhojan seva.
beats.picture: One card; the three words of its second row appear on the spoken words. Sakshi writes each, nodding.
beats.card: Card: 'UPAY · Vedic maanyata' + 'Sundarkand · Chaandi · Bhojan seva'

beats.line: Aur Mesh wale… is saal brake bhi, aur gym bhi.
beats.picture: Vishnu ji serene blessing with a playful smile; the ram doodle gently brakes at the STOP sign this time. Scroll closes with a glow.

beats.line: Aries dost ko bhejo. Poori case file, mahine-wise guide, link pe.
beats.picture: CTA. Sakshi alone (Vishnu ji not in this beat): the one wink of the reel, send arrow, then a big link chip.
Sakshi's diary shows 'ARIES 2027 ✓' with a ram doodle; Sakshi alone with her diary (no deity in the selling part). Card: 'Send to your Aries friend · Guide: link'. Loops to frame 0.
